gist.summary: Gen’s OAuth protected-resource metadata now advertises the supported scopes—generate, profile, usage, keys, and machines—and identifies the resource as “Pollinations API.” Enter’s authorization-server metadata uses the same scope list, so OAuth clients can discover what to request from either document. Authorization responses now include generate in the granted scope when requested, reflecting that generation is inherent to API keys; account permissions remain opt-in. Requests with no scopes still omit the scope field, while requests that receive no scopes return an empty scope.
